mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as long as the rate remains below this threshold.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve initiates aggressive rate hikes that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 620) and retail sales (RSAFS < 395000) signal a broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST < 620 and RSAFS < 395000, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative monetary policy to stimulate job growth, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in industrial production (INDPRO > 95.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity that correlates with strong corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts decline below 620,000 units (HOUST < 620), it signals a housing market contraction that reduces consumer spending confidence, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 620, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 390000) indicates weakening consumer demand ahead of economic peak, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5% and RSAFS < 390000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI inflation above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) and Fed rate cuts (FEDFUNDS < 0.1%) signal stagflationary pressure where monetary policy fails to control inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 0.1%, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
